description: Search CJEU and General Court case law — judgments, orders, and Advocate General opinions and views — by case number, court, case type, member state, procedure type and outcome, subject, keyword, and date range. A case number reaches every judgment, order, AG opinion, and AG view filed under it. By default only these primary records are returned; derivative judicial information notices, case abstracts, summaries, and corrigenda are excluded so distinct cases fill the page (set include_derivative to include them). Keyword matches English case titles (which carry party names) and CELEX strings; there is no full-text body search. member_state, procedure_type, outcome, and subject match the facts CELLAR records on each case, so a case it records none of a filtered fact for never matches. Returns each case with its CELEX number (whose sixth character names the court: C, T, or F), work URI, ECLI, date, and type; where CELLAR records them, its countries, procedure types with outcome, subjects, and procedure languages; and — parsed from the title where present — the formation, Advocate General, parties, referring court, subject matter, and case reference. The raw CELLAR title is returned only when those fields do not capture all of it.

case_number.description: Number of a single case: C-{num}/{year} (Court of Justice), T-{num}/{year} (General Court), or F-{num}/{year} (Civil Service Tribunal), e.g. C-131/12. Also accepts the case_reference form ("Case C-97/23 P."), any procedural suffix after the year (P, R, PPU, …), and a pre-1989 Court of Justice number with no prefix (26/62). A value naming more than one case ("C-131/12 and C-132/12") is rejected; search each separately. Matches the judgments, orders, AG opinions, and other primary records filed under that number; derivative records (notices, abstracts, summaries, corrigenda) join only under include_derivative. Numbered Opinions and Rulings of the Court of Justice ("Opinion 2/13", "Ruling 1/78") are not reached by a case number; look one up by its CELEX (e.g. 62013CV0002). A value made only of CELEX characters is matched as a CELEX substring instead, case-insensitively: one opening with the sector and year (62014CJ0362), the year and both letters (2013CJ0131), or both letters and the number (CJ0131) is answered from the CELEX index; any other (12CJ0131, 0131) tests every CELEX and can take tens of seconds.

anyOf.description: judgment, order (procedural decision), or ag_opinion (Advocate General opinion or view).

case_type.description: Case type: judgment, order (procedural decision), or ag_opinion (Advocate General opinion or view). Omit to search all.

anyOf.description: CJEU (C) = Court of Justice of the EU, GC (T) = General Court.

court.description: Court filter, by the court letter at position 6 of the CELEX: CJEU (C) = Court of Justice of the EU, GC (T) = General Court. It does not narrow by record type: every primary record the court filed matches, and its derivative records (notices, abstracts, summaries, corrigenda) join only under include_derivative. Omit to search every court.

date_from.description: Start of date range in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD). Leave blank or omit for no lower bound.

date_to.description: End of date range in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD). Leave blank or omit for no upper bound.

include_derivative.description: Include derivative sector-6 records — judicial information notices, case abstracts, case summaries, and corrigenda — alongside primary judgments, orders, AG opinions, and AG views. Default false: these are excluded so distinct primary cases fill the page. Ignored when case_type is set (that path already requires the selected primary type family). Has no effect beside member_state, procedure_type, outcome, or subject, since derivative records carry none of those facts.

keyword.description: Keyword matched against English case titles via the full-text index (multi-word input is treated as a phrase), and against CELEX numbers. A keyword that is a whole CELEX (e.g. 62023CO0097) matches that record, its numbered siblings (…(01) to …(20)), its _INF, _RES, _SUM, and _EXT records, and its corrigenda, with notices, abstracts, summaries, and corrigenda still joining only under include_derivative; for every record filed under a case, use case_number. A partial CELEX that opens with the sector and year (62013CJ), the year and type letters (2013CJ0131), or type letters followed by the number (CJ0131, J0131) matches every CELEX that holds it at that position; one opening with letters not followed by a digit (R(01)) tests every CELEX and can take tens of seconds; a bare year (2013) or a fragment opening mid-year or mid-number (013CJ0131, 0131) matches titles only. A keyword with no digit, or with a character no CELEX holds (a space, a period), matches titles only. A keyword with no letter or digit is rejected.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return, served up to 100 per call; a larger value (up to 10,000) is served at 100 and reported in limit_clamp. Defaults to 20.

member_state.description: Member state the case originates in, as CELLAR records it: the referring court's state on a preliminary reference, the defendant state on an action for failure to fulfil obligations, the applicant's state (or the member state party) on a direct action. A member state as its ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code (DEU, GRC, GBR for the United Kingdom) or two-letter code (DE; EL or GR for Greece; UK or GB), in any case: the 27 member states plus the United Kingdom. Cases CELLAR records no country for, Civil Service Tribunal staff cases among them, never match. Leave blank or omit to search every state.

offset.description: Pagination offset — number of results to skip. Defaults to 0. Must be below 10,000: CELLAR sorts at most 10,000 matches for one search, so pages stop at row 10,000; narrow with a date_from/date_to window to reach older cases.

outcome.description: Outcome CELLAR records with the procedure: successful, unfounded, inadmissible, or decision_unnecessary. With procedure_type, both hold on the same procedure (annulment with successful finds annulment actions that succeeded); alone, any procedure with that outcome. Preliminary references rarely record one. Omit to search all.

anyOf.description: preliminary_ruling, annulment, staff_case, appeal, failure_to_fulfil_obligations, damages, interim_measures, appeal_against_penalty, failure_to_act, or arbitration_clause.

procedure_type.description: Procedure type, as CELLAR classifies the case: preliminary_ruling (urgent references included), annulment, staff_case, appeal, failure_to_fulfil_obligations, damages, interim_measures, appeal_against_penalty, failure_to_act, or arbitration_clause. A case can carry several: an appeal also carries the action appealed. Each row lists its own in procedure_types. Omit to search all.

subject.description: Subject phrase matched against the English labels of CELLAR's case-law subject classification: the search covers every subject whose label contains each word of the phrase, in any case and also inside a longer word ("trade mark" matches "Trade marks", "personal data" "Protection of personal data", "tax" also "Taxation"). query_echo.subject_labels names the subjects matched; each row lists its own in subjects. This is not the title's subject_matter keywords. A phrase matching no label returns an empty page with a notice. Leave blank or omit to search every subject.

name: eurlex_get_cases

cap.description: The limit that was applied to this page.

cases.description: Matching case law records ordered by date descending, then by CELEX number ascending among records sharing a date, so pages are stable across calls.

items.description: A single CJEU or General Court case law record.

advocate_general.description: Advocate General who delivered the opinion, from an AG opinion title (e.g. "Jääskinen"). Absent on judgments and orders.

case_reference.description: Case reference parsed from the title (e.g. "Case C-97/23 P."). Absent when the title carries no case-reference segment.

countries.description: Countries CELLAR records the case as originating in, as ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 codes, sorted: the referring court's state on a preliminary reference, the defendant state on an action for failure to fulfil obligations, the applicant's state on a direct action. Member states, the values member_state takes, bar a few older direct actions by non-EU applicants. Absent when CELLAR records none, as on Civil Service Tribunal staff cases.

date.description: Judgment/opinion date in ISO 8601 format. Absent when CELLAR records no real document date — none, or the 1001-01-01 it records for an undated work; such cases sort last.

display_title.description: Clean human-readable title for display — the parties for a contested case (e.g. "Google Spain SL v AEPD"), or the court/AG descriptor when a case has no named parties. Parsed from the English title; absent when the record has none or its title carries no "#" segments.

ecli.description: European Case Law Identifier, the citation form of the record (e.g. "ECLI:EU:C:2014:317"); eurlex_lookup_celex resolves one back to its CELEX. Absent for judicial notices and the few records that carry none.

formation.description: Formation that decided, from the title's leading segment, verbatim (e.g. "Grand Chamber", "Full Court", "Fourth Chamber, Extended Composition"), or "President", "Vice-President", or "President of the Second Chamber" for an order issued by that office. Absent when the title names none, as older "Judgment of the Court of …" titles do.

parties.description: Parties to the case, parsed from the title (e.g. "WhatsApp Ireland Ltd v European Data Protection Board."). Absent when the title carries no parties segment (e.g. AG opinions).

procedure_languages.description: Languages of the case, as the two-letter codes eurlex_get_document takes as language, sorted. Absent when CELLAR records none, as on about half of the Court of Justice AG opinions and records dated before 1990.

procedure_types.description: Procedure types CELLAR classifies the case under, as English labels with the outcome where recorded ("Reference for a preliminary ruling", "Appeal - unfounded"), sorted; what procedure_type and outcome match. An appeal also lists the action appealed. Absent when CELLAR records none.

items.description: English procedure label, e.g. "Action for annulment - successful".

referring_court.description: National court that referred a preliminary ruling, from the title's referral segment (e.g. "Audiencia Nacional", or "Tariefcommissie - Netherlands" in older titles). Absent on direct actions and appeals.

resource_type.description: Human-readable case type label (e.g. "Judgment", "Order", "AG Opinion"). Cases with several resource-types (e.g. corrigenda) list all, comma-separated. Absent for some older cases.

subject_matter.description: Subject-matter keyword summary parsed from the title — the legal topics and provisions at issue. Free text, unlike subjects, CELLAR's subject classification. Absent when the title carries no subject-matter segment.

subjects.description: Subjects of CELLAR's case-law subject classification, as English labels, sorted; what subject matches. A controlled vocabulary, unlike the title's subject_matter keywords. Absent when CELLAR records none.

items.description: English subject label, e.g. "Protection of personal data".

title.description: Raw English expression title as stored in CELLAR, a "#"-delimited string (court, formation and date; parties; referral; subject matter; case reference). Present only when the parsed fields do not capture all of it: a segment the parser could not place, a judgment or order published by extracts ("(Extracts)"), a leading date that differs from date, or a title with no "#". Absent when the parse is complete, and for records with no English title.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `offset_past_window`: offset is 10,000 or more, past the last row CELLAR sorts for one search. `invalid_date_range`: date_from or date_to is not a real calendar date, or date_from falls after date_to. `invalid_case_number`: case_number is not a recognizable case number and holds characters no CELEX contains, names more than one case (e.g. "C-131/12 and C-132/12"), or is a prefix-less number dated outside 1953–1988. `invalid_keyword`: keyword holds no letters or digits, so no case title and no CELEX can match it. `invalid_subject`: subject holds no letters or digits, so no subject label can match it. `sparql_error`: CELLAR rejected the search it was sent: a filter combination its query planner cannot compile. The same call fails the same way again. `sparql_timeout`: The search ran past its time budget (retryable: CELLAR's response time varies, so a later search can finish), or CELLAR refused it as too costly to run (not retryable: the same search is refused again). Neither is retried within the call. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

has_more.description: True only when CELLAR returned an additional valid row beyond this page. False on a page that ends at row 10,000, the last one CELLAR sorts; its notice says whether more may match.

limit_clamp.description: Present only when limit exceeded the per-call maximum: the value asked for and the value served. The response follows the applied value.

applied.description: The limit served: the per-call maximum.

requested.description: The limit the call asked for.

next_offset.description: Offset for the next page. Present only when has_more is true.

notice.description: Guidance for the next call: on an empty first page, the filters that matched nothing and how to broaden them; when subject matched no subject label, that no case was searched; on a page with more rows, the offset to continue from; on a page ending at row 10,000, that no later page can be read and the closed date_from/date_to window that continues past it.

offset.description: Pagination offset used for this response.

query_echo.description: Echo of filters applied to this search. Useful for diagnosing empty results.

celex_fragment.description: CELEX pattern matched for case_number: year, court letter, and zero-padded case number, with * standing for any document letter that court files under a case number (e.g. "2023C*0097" reaches 62023CJ0097, 62023CO0097, and 62023CC0097). Absent when case_number was matched as a raw CELEX substring.

include_derivative.description: Effective include_derivative value after the false default is applied — whether derivative sector-6 records (notices, abstracts, summaries, corrigenda) were admitted alongside primary cases. Always present, since the default shapes which records can appear.

member_state.description: Member-state filter applied, as its ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code.

subject_labels.description: English labels of the subjects the subject phrase matched, sorted: the subjects the search was narrowed to. Empty when the phrase matched none, and then no case was searched. Absent when no subject was given.

shown.description: Number of cases returned in this page.

total.description: Number of cases returned in this page (not a corpus-wide count).

truncated.description: True when an additional CELLAR row proves more cases exist beyond this page.

title: Search CJEU/GC Case Law
